slug.description: Unique slug for your stream. Only contain lower case letters and digits

catchup_enabled.description: Set this value to True to enable catchup for the stream

watermark_area.description: Area of the watermark if watermark_id presents

ads_enabled.description: Enable or disable Ads for created stream

video_bitrate.description: Video bitrate in kilobit (max value is basic/growth = 2500, professional = 4500, enterprise = 6000)

resolution_width.description: resolution width (max value is basic/growth = 1920, professional = 2560, enterprise = 4096)

resolution_height.description: resolution height (max value is basic/growth = 1080, professional = 1080, enterprise = 2160)

secure_link_enabled.description: Enable or disable secure link for all videos in channel
